{{Quote|You must not assume that just because someone does not want to fight that they are not capable.|The Mountain Clan Matron, to [[Morgan Elsbeth]]|<ref name="The Path of Fear" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|female]] served as '''Matron''' of the [[Mountain Clan]], a [[Dathomiri clan|clan]] of Dathomiri [[witch]]es operating in the [[mountain]]s of the [[planet]] [[Dathomir]], during the [[Clone Wars]]. Following the [[Battle of Dathomir|massacre]] of the [[Nightsisters]] at the hands of [[General]] [[Grievous]], she briefly took in the orphaned Nightsister [[Morgan Elsbeth]] and brought Elsbeth to her [[Mountain Clan village|village]]. She was the [[Parent|mother]] of [[Nali]].<ref name="The Path of Fear" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Mountain Clan Matron could use a form of white energy<ref name="The Path of Fear AD">{{TOTE|The Path of Fear}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> to [[Teleportation (Force power)|teleport]] and make [[Force barrier|barriers]] around herself and create shockwaves capable of dispatching the [[droid]]s of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. She was also able to [[Force vision|see into the future]], as she saw the events of Morgan's own future and pitied her over what was to come.<ref name="The Path of Fear" />
